description: Website contact finder API for AI agents: send up to 5 websites and get, for each, the emails, phone numbers and social profile links printed on its home, contact and about pages, as JSON with the contact page that was found. Pay per website in stablecoins; a site where no contact was found is not charged and you are refunded for it. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.
